quests.title: Industrial Foregoing
quests.desc: &bIndustrial Foregoing&r (IF for short) is a tech mod that adds many machines with various different uses.\n\nTo get started, craft a &aPity Machine Frame&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Extracts latex from logs, runs faster when given power.\n\nCheck JEI for acceptable logs and Latex amounts. The best log to use is Acacia.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Pitiful Generator generates a small amount of FE using burnable fuels like Coal.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Turns Latex into Dry Rubber.

quests.title: Item Fluid Transport
quests.desc:
Transporters can be used to transport Items and/or Fluids between inventories that are 1 block away. You need a Transporter in the extraction side and another in the insertion side. To change these modes, right click the middle area.

You can have multiple transporter types in the same block. You can upgrade these with Addons. Speed to increase transfer speed, Efficiency to increase transfer amount.

quests.title: Latex
quests.desc: Latex is a fluid used to make Dry Rubber, but it can also be used for some things in the Dissolution Chamber.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: When Rubber is smelted it turns into Plastic, which is the main resource in Industrial Foregoing.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Plastic is the main resource of &bIndustrial Foregoing&r, you now have access to some very useful machines!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Dissolution Chamber is used to craft more advanced machines.\n\nYou will need to put a certain fluid in it along with the items needed for what you are crafting. Check JEI.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Passive Mobs -> More Pink Slime
Hostile Mobs -> More Meat

quests.title: Pink Slime Liquid Meat
quests.desc: Passive Mobs -> More Pink Slime.\nHostile Mobs -> More Meat.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Conveyors are another way to transport stuff. They work with items, entites, and even fluids. They can interact with the world with Conveyor Upgrades.

You can upgrade conveyors with Glowstone to make them faster, and with Plastic to stop them from picking up items.

quests.title: Blocks
quests.desc: These machines are used to automate block placing/breaking. This is especially useful when automating latex.

quests.title: Animals
quests.desc:
The Animal Rancher shears &zSheep&r and milks &8C&ro&8w&rs.

The Animal Feeder feeds animals so they can breed.

The Animal Baby Separator teleports babies behind it.

All of these machines support Range Addons.

quests.title: Plants
quests.desc:
The Plant Gatherer harvests plants in its working area. Harvested plants can give &#5919B6Sludge&r, which can be used in a Sludge Refiner. When supplied with &bEther Gas&r, the Plant Gatherer will automatically replant crops.

The Plant Sower automatically plants crops and saplings. It has 9 color coded inventory slots, which correspond to the colored markings on top of the Plant Sower. The working area of the machine is divided into 9 segments, which correspond to the various inventory slots.

Both of these machines support Range Addons.

quests.title: Bio Power
quests.desc: The Bioreactor uses Biofuel made from the Biofuel Generator to generate FE.

quests.title: Sewer
quests.sub: Fresh from the Manure Field, your spookiness
quests.desc: The Sewer is used to make Sewage, which is used to make Fertilizer.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Meat through a tube, yummy.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Hydroponic Bed uses Energy and &9Water&r to grow crops and saplings planted on it. It supports pretty much any crop you can imagine. You can also provide &bEther Gas&r so the machine automatically harvests the crop and puts the crop's results into its internal buffer. This can also gather crop data for a Hydroponic Simulation Processor, to use in a Simulated Hydroponic Bed.

Saplings will require space to grow.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Mob Detector will detect entities in its working area, and output a redstone signal behind it with strength equal to the amount of entities in the working area.

This machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Marine Fisher can fish automatically. Can catch fish, treasures, enchanted books, and some other stuff. Can't catch bees, though, you'll have to fish manually for that one.

Must be placed above a 3x3 &9Water&r pool (or bigger).

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Applies &lBone Meal&r or &#8B4513Fertilizer&r to plants in its working area. This will continue applying &#8B4513Fertilizer&r to the same crop until that crop can no longer accept &lBone Meal&r before moving on to the next plant. This means that the machine can get stuck on plants that always accept &lBone Meal&r, such as &eSunflowers&r, or plants that never reach their final growth state.

This machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Remember that Not-An-Ore-Doctor fella? The Washing Factory fills in for him, to handle the Raw Ore Meat from the Washing Factory, turning it into Fermented Ore Meat. This machine has 4 modes.

1. 2x ore processing rate, 5 seconds to process.
2. 3x ore processing rate, 45 seconds to process.
3. 4x ore processing rate, 120 seconds to process. Uses &#FF69B4Pink Slime&r as a catalyst.
4. 5x ore processing rate, 300 seconds to process. Uses &bEther Gas&r as a catalyst.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Only used for one thing.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Yes, &bIndustrial Foregoing&r has ore processing too. This one uses &6Liquid Meat&r to convert an ore into Raw Ore Meat. I'm not an ore doctor, so I can't exactly do anything with this Raw Ore Meat. Maybe give it to the Fermentation Station?

quests.title: Laser Drill
quests.desc: Suggestion: Use some sort of Wither-Proof Glass.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Laser Lens can make Ore Lasers focus more on a certain color of ore. Check in JEI to see what lens work best for a certain type of ore. It also determines what fluid type can be produced by Fluid Lasers.

quests.title: Ether Gas
quests.sub: No, it's not a Mekanism Chemical, it's Wither Milk

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Enchantment Factory is basically an automated Enchanting Table. When provided with Gear/Books and &aEssence&r, it will enchant that item with something random. This machine can use fluids from tanks directly above it, to allow for an increased potential for enchanting gear and books.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Enchantment Applicator is an automated Anvil. It can apply Enchanted Books to gear automatically. Uses &aEssence&r in place of &aExperience&r. This machine can use fluids from tanks directly above it, to allow for an increased potential for enchanting gear.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: This machine can sort enchanted items and unenchanted items. The enchanted items end up in the top inventory, while the unenchanted items end up in the bottom inventory.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Enchantment Extractor can automatically remove enchantments from gear. You can have it either go onto a Book, or have the enchantment be converted into &aEssence&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
It brews potions. Much like a standard Brewing Stand, it requires Blaze Powder as fuel, and uses bottles. Unlike a Brewing Stand, though, it can autofill those bottles with water.

Unlike with other quests where I give a brief overview of the machine, I will provide a setup in another quest to automate this machine, as it is fairly janky and unintuitive in some areas.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Basically the spawner of &bIndustrial Foregoing&r. It uses &aEssence&r along with a mob in a Mob Imprisonment Tool to spawn a copy of that mob.

Bosses and other mobs that cannot be put into a spawner* are blacklisted from the Mob Duplicator as well.

*&8With a few exceptions, hold SHIFT on a spawn egg while advanced tooltips (F3 + H) are enabled to see if you can find the Mob Duplicator Blacklist tag.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Ever heard of a cobblestone generator? The Material StoneWork Factory works like one, but takes it to the next level. You can get it to crush stone into gravel, sand, silicon, you can get it to smelt it into stone, you can make Obsidian with it, and whatever else JEI shows for this machine.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Stasis Chamber can hold mobs in place in its working area. The mobs held under stasis are also healed by the Chamber. Need more healing? Get some addons!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Mob Crusher &ldeletes&r mobs in its working area, collecting that mob's loot, as well as converting the &aExperience&r that mob would get into &aEssence&r. You can also optionally use the would be Experience to apply Looting to the Mob Crusher instead.

Bosses and other mobs that cannot go into spawners are "blacklisted" from the Mob Crusher. Instead of being &ldeleted&r, they take 75 damage per operation.

This machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The final step of the ore processing lineup of &bIndustrial Foregoing&r, the Fluid Sieving Machine. This will use sand to filter out the useful part of Fermented Ore Meat, giving us some dust. Do whatever you want with that dust. Smelt it, mix it into an alloy.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Infinity Charger is your best option for charging Infinity Tools. It holds a &llot&r of FE, perfect for the Infinity Tools.

It can charge other stuff, too.

quests.title: Infinity Tools
quests.desc:
Infinity Tools, so called because of their ability to be charged near-infinitely. Increasing the tier of the tool can give said tool special perks. Having &5Biofuel&r in them will make them more efficient, by consuming the fuel instead of power when used.

There are 7 tiers:
Poor
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Artifact

To learn more about each Infinity Tool, check out Industrial Foregoing's Manual (so that I don't have to cover so many infinity tools in one quest)!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Wither Builder, as its name implies, builds Withers. It's part of the Wither's Compass for the ATM Star.

&8You may want to encase the Wither Builder in some witherproof glass, to prevent Withers from blowing it up.

quests.title: The Mycelial Reactor
quests.desc:
&bМіцеліальний реактор&r складається з усіх міцеліальних генераторів, що працюють одночасно біля блоку реактора, і виробляє загалом &a25MFE/т&r.

Все звучить добре, але вам потрібно автоматизувати деякі речі, щоб він працював: дізнайтеся, що споживає кожен міцеліальний генератор, і автоматизуйте це. Більшість речей прості, але деякі — не дуже... &oдивимось на Disenchanting Mycelial Generator&r.

Але після повної автоматизації ви не зобов'язані зупинятися на одному — можна створити ще більше реакторів.

quests.title: Understanding Ether Gas
quests.desc:
Getting your first &bEther Gas&r might be a little bit scary.\n\n&bEther Gas&r is made from drilling a Wither, using a Fluid Drill with a &5Purple Lens&r.

But don't worry about the Wither, Industrial Foregoing has a machine just to help you with that task. The &4Stasis Chamber&r is a machine that freezes in place anything that is on top of it in a 3x3 area, including the Wither.

&cHope you don't run out of power, because if you do... I hope you're ready to fight the &0Wither&c.

quests.title: Latex and Plastic? Huh?
quests.desc:
In &bIndustrial Foregoing&r, one of the main resources is &fLatex.&r Its used to craft Machine Frames, needed to make machines and upgrades.

Making Latex is pretty simple, &aFluid Extractor&r extracts Latex from &6Logs&r (Acacia gives the most).

------------------------

Now about making Plastic: Plastic results from smelting Dry Rubber - which is made in the &aLatex Processing Unit&r, that transforms Latex into Dry Rubber.

&bSo basically Latex -> Dry Rubber -> Plastic.

quests.title: AllRightsReserved
quests.desc:
Цей квест був створений &6командою AllTheMods&r або &2учасником спільноти&r для використання у збірках AllTheMods.

Оскільки всі збірки &6AllTheMods&r ліцензовані як &eВсі права захищено&r, цей квест не дозволяється використовувати у жодних публічних збірках, які не випущені командою &6AllTheMods Team&r без явного дозволу.

Цей квест навмисно прихований, якщо ви його бачите — ви перебуваєте в режимі редагування.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Used to trap and transport mobs easily.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: It's at least more versatile than the ingot.

quests.title: Upgrades
quests.desc: Used to make machines better.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Sludge Refiner can use &#5919B6Sludge&r to produce stuff like Dirt, Gravel, Soul Sand...whatever...check JEI for the rest.

quests.title: Simulated Hydroponic Bed
quests.desc:
Ever feel like the standard Hydroponic Bed is too laggy? Can't fit enough Soul Surges? Allow me to introduce the Simulated Hydroponic Bed. This will use a Hydroponic Simulation Processor and a seed/sapling to grow any crop of your choice...virtually. You don't even need &9Water&r and &bEther Gas&r for this one. On top of this, Hydroponic Simulation Processors get better over time as they grow more crops, though the rate at which it scales is slower in a Simulated Hydroponic Bed.

Don't even bother trying to maximize the Processor. It will take an unfathomably long time. Much longer than what it would take for me to make the quests for Ender IO, for sure.

quests.title: Industrial Foregoing Souls
quests.desc:
&bIndustrial Foregoing &#27AEB9Souls&r adds machines to allow you to accelerate other machinery.

The &#27AEB9Soul Laser Base&r is the heart of this, working similarly to a Fluid Laser Base extracting Ether Gas from a Wither. It uses &9Blue Laser Lens&r to extract &#27AEB9Souls&r from a &#27AEB9Warden&r, which can be extracted with &#27AEB9Soul Pipes&r, or used with one of the two major digital storage mods (AE2 and RS). These &#27AEB9Souls&r will be used by &#27AEB9Soul Surges&r, in order to accelerate blocks.

Extracting &#27AEB9Souls&r from the &#27AEB9Warden&r is a &4&lpainful&r process to the creature, meaning it takes damage from the process, and can even die from it. Stasis Chambers are highly recommended, especially with upgrades to make the healing faster.
{@pagebreak}
Ensure there's a 3 block gap between the floor and the &#27AEB9Soul Laser Base&r, like so:
{image:atm:textures/questpics/industrialforegoing/soul_laser_gap.png width:100 height:100 align:center}
Additionally, ensure the &#27AEB9Warden&r has fully emerged before putting it under stasis.

quests.title: Soulplied Energistics
quests.desc:
If you prefer not bringing &#27AEB9Soul Pipes&r around, you can use AE2 instead.

You can put an ME Storage Bus on top of the &#27AEB9Soul Laser Base&r to allow your ME network to access the &#27AEB9Souls&r inside. These can be requested to be held in ME Interfaces.

quests.title: Soul Storage?
quests.desc:
Buuz135 (developer of &bIndustrial Foregoing&r) didn't want Souls to be a resource you store. Ultramega makes it storable anyway.

Tip: Use a Regulator Upgrade to prevent the Exporter from dumping all your souls into the connected Soul Pipe.

quests.title: Automating the Potion Brewer

tasks.name: ME Export Bus OR ME Interface

quests.title: Wrenches that work with IF Machines
quests.desc:
I found myself annoyed at being unable to rotate &bIndustrial Foregoing&r Machines with most Wrenches. To help with this, I have compiled a list of all the wrenches that I can find that are capable of rotating &bIF&r machines. These were tested primarily on the Laser Drill, so the results will focus primarily on that. Some wrenches might not work with other machines.

Click the task in this quest to view all valid Wrenches for this quest.

tasks.name: Wrenches that work with IF Machines
